user.title: Work Pro Integra
user.description: Enter your Integra's network details. The default UDP port is 50000. On the device, enable the "central control reply" switch under "Device Setting".

error.cannot_connect: Connection failed. Check IP, port and whether "central control reply" is enabled on the device.

inputs.title: Name the inputs
inputs.description: Optional name per input (fields are 0-based: input_name_0 = input 1). Pre-filled with the device name – leave as is to keep it.

outputs.title: Name the outputs
outputs.description: Optional name per output (0-based: output_name_0 = output 1). Pre-filled with the device name.
